name: Querio
description: AI 分析平台，帮助数据团队在 Claude、ChatGPT 和 Slack 等多个 AI 工具中提供一致的答案，将公司报表、定义和分析逻辑存储在 GitHub 中，由数据团队审核每一项变更后再发布
description_en: AI analytics platform that helps data teams deliver consistent answers across Claude, ChatGPT, and Slack by keeping company reports, definitions, and analysis in GitHub, with data team review for every change
why_matters: 解决企业在多个 AI 工具中获得冲突答案的痛点，通过将分析逻辑从供应商产品中解放出来存储在 GitHub，并使用 AI agent 自动更新受影响的报表和定义，实现了数据团队对 AI 输出的可控性和一致性
why_matters_en: Solves the conflicting answers problem across AI tools by liberating analytics logic from vendor products into GitHub, using AI agents to auto-update affected reports while maintaining data team control and consistency
latest_news: 2026年10月27日推出并宣布获得总计448万欧元融资，种子轮由 BMW i Ventures 领投
latest_news_en: Launched October 27, 2026 with €4.48 million total funding, Seed round led by BMW i Ventures
source_title: London’s Querio launches with €4.48 million to help companies and their data teams tackle conflicting answers across AI tools | EU-Startups

evidence.quote: Querio, a London-based analytics platform for data teams and their AI agents, has launched today with €4.48 million ($5 million) in total funding. Its investors include BMW i Ventures, which led the company's Seed financing
Founded in 2024 by Rami Abi Habib (CEO) and Bonilla (CTO)

For thirty years, analytics tools have kept a company's logic inside the vendor's product, where it's hard to move and hard for AI to work with. Now everyone is asking data questions in Claude, Slack and wherever else they work, and they get three different revenue numbers. We built Querio so the data team owns that logic, and every AI tool in the company answers from it

name: Drylab AI
description: 面向科学家的AI代理平台,自动处理研究数据分析。用户提出问题后,系统会起草分析计划、从800多个内置数据源选择工具、运行分析、解释结果并自动修复错误。平台内置自研验证模型,基于真实科学分析训练,用于审计数据处理流程并标记错误。支持本地部署,数据留在客户服务器内
description_en: AI agent platform for scientists that automates research data analysis. Users pose questions and the system drafts analysis plans, selects from 800+ built-in data sources and tools, runs analyses, interprets results and fixes errors autonomously. Includes proprietary verification model trained on real-world scientific analyses to audit data handling and flag errors. Supports on-premise deployment keeping data on customer servers
why_matters: 越南创业者打造的科研AI工具已获得美欧亚付费客户,包括制药公司、癌症治疗中心、生物医学研究所和大学,在资本密集的科研AI赛道与Lila Sciences、FutureHouse和谷歌竞争。自研验证模型是其技术差异化关键
why_matters_en: Vietnamese-founded research AI tool has secured paying customers across US, Europe and Asia including pharma companies, cancer centers, biomedical institutes and universities, competing against better-capitalized rivals like Lila Sciences, FutureHouse and Google. Proprietary verification model represents key technical differentiation
latest_news: 2025年成立,刚完成300万美元种子轮融资,由Vertex Ventures东南亚印度基金领投,专利分析平台PatSnap跟投。将用于扩展企业销售、招聘工程师和生物学家、获得国际研究机构安全合规认证
latest_news_en: Founded in 2025, raised $3M seed round led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India with participation from PatSnap. Funds will expand enterprise sales, hire engineers and biologists, and obtain security and compliance certifications for international research organizations
source_title: Ho Chi Minh City Opens Its Doors To Capital As Research Still Lacks A Bridge To Business | Vietcetera

website_verification.title: AI Bioinformatics Platform for Biomedical Research | Drylab

evidence.quote: Drylab AI, a startup founded by Vietnamese entrepreneurs, has raised $3 million in a seed round. Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India led the round, with participation from PatSnap

The platform also runs a verification model that Drylab developed in-house and trained on real-world scientific analyses. The model audits how the platform handles data and flags errors so the system can correct its results
The platform already has paying customers in the US, Europe and Asia, including pharmaceutical companies, cancer treatment centers, biomedical research institutes and universities

OmniClaw was taken up by around 300 brands within two months of its June launch. The number of brands using the Marketing Agent tripled over the same period.

name: Dream
description: 面向建筑、工程和施工行业开发的AI世界模型平台,通过结构认知方法自动化建筑设计和工程,基于超过1亿平方英尺的建筑数据训练,能够生成结构精确的设计并考虑内部建筑元素
description_en: AI world model platform for architecture, engineering, and construction that automates building design and engineering through structural cognition approach, trained on over 100 million square feet of building data, generating structurally precise designs accounting for internal elements
why_matters: Dream是唯一开发出能即时设计整栋建筑的世界模型的公司,其模型基于真实物理和建筑标准,理解墙内结构、材料和承重能力,旨在取代Autodesk AutoCAD和Revit等过时的AEC工具,已在德克萨斯州和加利福尼亚州的10个活跃项目中部署
why_matters_en: Dream is the only company that developed a world model that instantly designs whole buildings, grounded in real physics and construction standards, understanding internal structures, materials and weight capacity, aiming to replace outdated AEC tools like Autodesk's AutoCAD and Revit, already deployed across 10 active projects in Texas and California
latest_news: 2026年10月从a16z领投的种子轮融资中获得1700万美元,其他投资方包括SV Angel、XYZ和Zigg Capital,已从隐身模式中浮现
latest_news_en: Emerged from stealth in October 2026 with $17 million in seed funding led by Andreessen Horowitz, alongside SV Angel, XYZ, and Zigg Capital
source_title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction

evidence.quote: Dream has emerged from stealth with $17 million in seed funding led by Andreessen Horowitz, alongside other backers, including SV Angel, XYZ, and Zigg Capital.

Andy Elder and Arjun Mathur were Stanford roommates who both studied computer science before spending a decade at Palantir. Elder led product design for a team of 800 people building software for U.S. defense and intelligence agencies, while Mathur served as a senior vice president in the company's commercial practice.
Elder and Mathur claim that they are the only ones that developed a world model that instantly designs whole buildings.

description: 企业 AI 代理身份管理与治理平台,提供 MCP 网关授权云服务访问、LLM 网关路由和成本控制、代理身份授权管理及全公司代理监控

why_matters_en: Founded by Coursera's founding engineer and TensorFlow co-creator, raised $11M with backing from top AI scientists including Jeff Dean and Andrej Karpathy, achieved 50 enterprise customers since February launch, differentiating in crowded agent management space through ease of deployment and founders' deep enterprise AI background
latest_news: 2026 年 10 月完成由 Cowboy Ventures 领投的 700 万美元种子轮融资,Coatue、Operator Collective、Hustle Fund 及 Okta 联合创始人 Frederic Kerrest、前 Google 首席科学家 Jeff Dean、OpenAI 联合创始人 Andrej Karpathy 等天使投资人参投,累计融资 1100 万美元
latest_news_en: Raised $7M seed round led by Cowboy Ventures in October 2026, with participation from Coatue, Operator Collective, Hustle Fund, and angels including Okta co-founder Frederic Kerrest, former Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean, and OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy, bringing total funding to $11M
source_title: Agent identity startup Mintive lands Cowboy Ventures, Coatue, angels Jeff Dean, Andrej Karpathy

evidence.quote: Mintive has raised $11 million total, including a newly announced $7 million seed led by Cowboy Ventures. Additional investors include Coatue, Operator Collective, and Hustle Fund; angels include Okta co-founder Frederic Kerrest, Discovery Loop co-founder and former Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean, and OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy, among others.

Ngiam, Mintive's CEO, was the founding engineer of Coursera (employee No. 1, hired by Andrew Ng). Ngiam later worked on neural networks at Google Brain. Vasudevan, the company's CTO, is best known as one of the co-creators of TensorFlow while he was at Google Brain.

name: Warhound
description: 通过基因工程和 AI 技术打造增强型军犬的国防科技公司,专注于为美国军方、执法机构和紧急响应团队提供改良的工作犬。由 Colossal Biosciences 的 Ben Lamm 和 Anduril 的 Palmer Luckey 联合创立,使用基因编辑技术增强军犬的健康、寿命和性能指标(如速度、嗅觉灵敏度),并配备 Anduril 提供的智能硬件(防护背心、护目镜、数据传感器)以提升战场态势感知和人犬协同能力。
description_en: Defense technology company engineering genetically enhanced military working dogs using AI and biotechnology for the U.S. military, law enforcement, and emergency response teams. Co-founded by Ben Lamm (Colossal Biosciences) and Palmer Luckey (Anduril), the company uses gene editing to improve dog health, longevity, and performance (speed, olfactory sensors) while equipping them with Anduril's smart hardware (protective vests, goggles, data sensors) for enhanced situational awareness and handler coordination.
why_matters: 解决美国军方 80% 以上工作犬依赖欧洲进口且不足一半合格的供应链瓶颈,通过基因编辑消除遗传性疾病(视力缺陷、癌症易感性、髋关节发育不良),并结合 Anduril 的智能装备实现人犬协同的数字化升级,为国防和公共安全领域创造垂直整合的生物-硬件解决方案。
why_matters_en: Addresses the critical supply chain bottleneck where over 80% of U.S. military working dogs are imported from Europe with less than half fit for service. Uses gene editing to eliminate inherited health issues (poor eyesight, cancer predisposition, hip dysplasia) while integrating Anduril's smart gear for digitized human-dog coordination, creating a vertically integrated bio-hardware solution for defense and public safety.
latest_news: 2026年10月22日宣布完成2亿美元融资并正式出圈,由红杉资本、8VC、Corner Ventures 和中情局支持的 In-Q-Tel 投资,投后估值12亿美元。首批克隆犬预计2027年初诞生,两年内投入实战服务。
latest_news_en: Emerged from stealth on October 22, 2026 with $200M funding from Sequoia, 8VC, Corner Ventures, and CIA-backed In-Q-Tel at a $1.2B valuation. First batch of cloned dogs expected early 2027, with service deployment targeted within two years.
source_title: Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs and arm them with Anduril gear

evidence.quote: On Thursday, that idea came out of stealth as Warhound, backed by $200 million in funding from investors including Sequoia, 8VC, Corner Ventures, and In-Q-Tel, a venture firm backed by the CIA and other U.S. intelligence agencies. The round values the company at $1.2 billion.
Colossal Biosciences' Ben Lamm and Anduril's Palmer Luckey had an idea to genetically engineer war dogs for the U.S. military, law enforcement, and other emergency response teams.

more than 80% of the U.S. military's working dogs come from Europe, and less than half of them are fit for service. That means the supply of working dogs is dwindling, and the U.S. increasingly relies on foreign nations for dogs that play an important role in the military and in law enforcement. Warhound aims to change that.
